'''Christoph''' was a [[human]] lumberjack who worked at the [[Northwind Logging Camp]] when it was raided by the [[Defias Brotherhood]]. He was unable to flee from the bandits, which his friend [[Old Hamilton]] noted when he and his daughter Mirabelle were tending to the injured. Mirabelle sent an adventurer to find him for his son Arnold, but a '''Mangled Corpse''' was all that remained of him.
